title: Hydroxysafflor yellow A regulates lymphangiogenesis and inflammation via the inhibition of PI3K on regulating AKT/mTOR and NF-kappaB pathway in macrophages to reduce atherosclerosis in ApoE-/- mice.
authors: Feng, Xiaoteng; Du, Min; Li, Sijin; Zhang, Yifan; Ding, Jie; Wang, Jiarou; Wang, Yiru; Liu, Ping
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HSYA通过抑制PI3K调节巨噬细胞炎症和淋巴管生成以减轻动脉粥样硬化，虽含分子对接但核心为药物-蛋白作用，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Macrophage-mediated inflammatory infiltration and pathological lymphangiogenesis around atherosclerotic plaques are newly highlighted treatment targets of atherosclerosis. Although the effect of Hydroxysafflor yellow A(HSYA) on atherosclerosis was clear, few studies focus on the regulation of HSYA on such mechanisms. PURPOSE: This study aimed to uncover the key site of HSYA on improving atherosclerosis by regulating macrophage-induced inflammation and lymphangiogenesis. STUDY DESIGN: This study was designed to explore the new mechanism of HSYA on alleviating atherosclerosis in vitro and in vivo. METHODS: We determined the expression of vascular endothelial growth factor C(VEGF-C) in Raw264.7 cells and high-fat diet fed ApoE knockout (ApoE(-/-)) mice. Raw264.7 cells were treated with HSYA under the stimulation of LPS and ox-LDL. HFD induced ApoE(-/-) mice were given different concentrations of HSYA-saline solution by tail vein injection and ATV-saline suspension by gavage. C57/B6j mice fed with chow diet were used for the control group. H&E, oil red O and immunofluorescence staining analysis were used for visualizing the pathological changes. The biological impact of HSYA was evaluated by body weight, lipid metabolism, inflammation levels, and corresponding function indexes of kidney and liver. RT-qPCR and western blot methods were conducted to determine the expression of the inflammation and lymphangiogenesis factors. Molecular docking and microscale thermophoresis analysis were used to verify the combination of HSYA and PI3K. RESULTS: In vivo, HSYA reduced the plaque formation, hepatic steatosis and inflammation-related lymphangiogenesis (IAL). It also changed the serum levels of inflammation (VEGF-C, TNF-alpha, IL-6, VCAM1, MCP1), lipid indexes (LDL, CHOL, TRIG) and relevant lymphangiogenesis (VEGF-C and LYVE-1) and inflammation (VCAM-1 and IL-6) signals in the aorta. In vitro, HSYA regulated Akt/mTOR and NF-kappaB activation by the inhibition of PI3K in macrophages. CONCLUSION: HSYA affects inflammation and inflammation-associated lymphangiogenesis via suppressing PI3K to affect AKT/mTOR and NF-B pathway activation in macrophages, showing a comprehensive protective effect on atherosclerosis.
abstract_zh: 背景：巨噬细胞介导的炎症浸润和动脉粥样硬化斑块周围的病理性淋巴管生成是新近被强调的动脉粥样硬化治疗靶点。尽管羟基红花黄色素A（HSYA）对动脉粥样硬化的作用已明确，但很少有研究关注HSYA对这些机制的调控。目的：本研究旨在揭示HSYA通过调控巨噬细胞诱导的炎症和淋巴管生成改善动脉粥样硬化的关键位点。研究设计：本研究旨在体外和体内探索HSYA缓解动脉粥样硬化的新机制。方法：我们测定了Raw264.7细胞和高脂饮食喂养的ApoE敲除（ApoE(-/-)）小鼠中血管内皮生长因子C（VEGF-C）的表达。在LPS和ox-LDL刺激下，用HSYA处理Raw264.7细胞。对高脂饮食诱导的ApoE(-/-)小鼠，通过尾静脉注射给予不同浓度的HSYA-生理盐水溶液，并通过灌胃给予阿托伐他汀（ATV）-生理盐水混悬液。以普通饮食喂养的C57/B6j小鼠作为对照组。采用H&E、油红O和免疫荧光染色分析观察病理变化。通过体重、脂质代谢、炎症水平以及相应的肾和肝功能指标评估HSYA的生物学影响。采用RT-qPCR和western blot方法测定炎症和淋巴管生成因子的表达。使用分子对接和微量热泳动分析验证HSYA与PI3K的结合。结果：在体内，HSYA减少了斑块形成、肝脂肪变性和炎症相关淋巴管生成（IAL）。它还改变了血清中炎症因子（VEGF-C、TNF-α、IL-6、VCAM1、MCP1）、脂质指标（LDL、CHOL、TRIG）以及主动脉中相关淋巴管生成（VEGF-C和LYVE-1）和炎症（VCAM-1和IL-6）信号的水平。在体外，HSYA通过抑制巨噬细胞中的PI3K调控Akt/mTOR和NF-κB激活。结论：HSYA通过抑制PI3K影响巨噬细胞中AKT/mTOR和NF-κB通路激活，从而影响炎症和炎症相关淋巴管生成，显示出对动脉粥样硬化的综合保护作用。
